color.note: Values are the OKLCH sources from app.css. Dark is "night sky", not inverted light. Primary and ring flip to dawn in dark.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page background (never pure white or black).

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Body text on background, card, popover and surface-2.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, day headers (at 95% with backdrop blur), the paywall radio cards.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on card.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers; a step above card in dark.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on popover.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Inset areas and timeline lanes.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary buttons and selected choice cards. Flips hue: deep indigo in light, dawn in dark.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill. In light it is also the light text on bg-sky.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons, chips, the completed-trip badge.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on secondary.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: the active desktop nav pill, progress tracks, skeletons, row hover.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text (meta, hints, section labels) on background, card and muted.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hover fill; warm in light, cool violet in dark.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on accent.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Errors and delete actions only; as text on background and card.

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on a destructive fill.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: cards, header and tab-bar edges, dividers.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Form field borders. Note: as in the source, about 1.4:1 on background in light and 1.6:1 in dark - under the 3:1 control-border floor; fields rely on their label and fill. Kept exact, flagged.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus outline and ring (2px). Indigo in light, dawn in dark.

tokens.name: dawn
tokens.usage: (About 2.4:1 on light background: never text there.) The one warm accent - "you" and "now": active badge fill, progress fill, selected radio card border, the CTA on bg-sky, check icons. Fill and border only on light surfaces; use dawn-text for text.

tokens.name: dawn-text
tokens.usage: Dawn-coloured text on light surfaces (eyebrows, the active tab label, day headlines). Passes AA where dawn does not. Inside bg-sky it switches back to dawn.

tokens.name: dawn-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a dawn fill.

tokens.name: now
tokens.usage: The red-orange "now" line across the timeline lanes. Never used for anything else.

tokens.name: cat-sleep
tokens.usage: Plan category fill: sleep, naps and rest (with solid / dots / hatch as the second signal).

tokens.name: cat-sleep-fg
tokens.usage: Text and icons on cat-sleep.

tokens.name: cat-light
tokens.usage: Plan category fill: seek bright light (solid, Sun icon). A pale fill on light surfaces (about 1.5:1), so its icon and cat-light-fg label are required.

tokens.name: cat-light-fg
tokens.usage: Text and icons on cat-light.

tokens.name: cat-moderate
tokens.usage: Plan category fill: light is fine (dots + dashed border) and neutral light (solid).

tokens.name: cat-moderate-fg
tokens.usage: Text and icons on cat-moderate; at 40% it is the dashed border of light-is-fine.

tokens.name: cat-dark
tokens.usage: Plan category fill: avoid light (hatch, Glasses icon). In dark it sits about 1.4:1 from background, so the hatch, icon and label carry it - never ship an avoid-light block without them.

tokens.name: cat-dark-fg
tokens.usage: Text and icons on cat-dark.

tokens.name: cat-caffeine
tokens.usage: Plan category fill: caffeine serving (dots), routine (hatch), OK window (solid); the dashed border of no-caffeine.

tokens.name: cat-caffeine-fg
tokens.usage: Text and icons on cat-caffeine.

tokens.name: cat-travel
tokens.usage: Plan category fill: flights, transfers, movement breaks, zone changes (solid) and layovers (hatch).

tokens.name: cat-travel-fg
tokens.usage: Text and icons on cat-travel.

tokens.name: sky-top
tokens.usage: bg-sky gradient stop at 0%: night indigo.

tokens.name: sky-mid
tokens.usage: bg-sky gradient stop: violet (55% in light, 60% in dark).

tokens.name: sky-horizon
tokens.usage: bg-sky gradient stop at 100%: the dawn horizon.

tokens.name: sky-title
tokens.usage: Titles and light text on bg-sky (primary-foreground in light, foreground in dark). Keep it in the indigo-violet upper part: over the light-theme horizon it drops to about 2.2:1, so copy that runs low sits on sky-copy-background.

tokens.name: sky-copy
tokens.usage: Paragraph copy set on the sky-copy-background backplate inside bg-sky.

tokens.name: sky-copy-background
tokens.usage: Translucent backplate (background at 90%) behind longer copy on bg-sky, so it stays AA over the dawn horizon.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 - an alias of cat-sleep.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2 - an alias of cat-light.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3 - an alias of cat-travel.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: shadcn sidebar slot - alias of card (no sidebar ships today).

tokens.name: sidebar-foreground
tokens.usage: Alias of foreground.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary
tokens.usage: Alias of primary.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Alias of primary-foreground.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent
tokens.usage: Alias of secondary.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Alias of secondary-foreground.

tokens.name: sidebar-border
tokens.usage: Alias of border.

tokens.name: sidebar-ring
tokens.usage: Alias of ring.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Fraunces, variable with optical size, 400-500 only. Never bold. letter-spacing -0.01em.

styles.name: hero
styles.sample: Plan your clock shift for your next trip

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: Page titles on phones (text-3xl), also the IATA codes on trip cards.

styles.name: page-title-lg
styles.sample: Your body keeps its own clock

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Card and dialog titles, the zone-change card (text-2xl).

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Section titles, the Today panel day label (text-xl).

styles.name: day-title
styles.usage: Sticky day headers on the timeline (text-lg).

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Figtree for all UI and body, including section labels inside cards. Times, dates and counts always get tabular numerals (tnum).

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Seek bright light outdoors for 30 minutes.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default UI copy; secondary copy in muted-foreground (text-sm).

styles.name: priority-tag
styles.usage: The smallest tag: priority and reason chips (text-[10px] font-medium).

spacing.note: Tailwind v4 4px grid: every spacing utility is a multiple of `spacing`. Page gutter px-4; cards p-5 on phones, p-6/p-8 wider; gap-6 between sections, gap-2-3 inside rows.

tokens.name: spacing
tokens.usage: The Tailwind base unit: p-5 = 5 x spacing.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in dense blocks, chip gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside rows and chip groups (gap-2).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between items in a row, swatch-to-title (gap-3).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page gutter (px-4).

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones (p-5).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding wider, and the gap between sections (gap-6).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large feature cards and the paywall header top (p-8, pt-8).

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: App header height (h-14), the sticky offset of day headers (top-14), Today rows (min-h-14).

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Phone bottom tab bar height (h-16).

radius.note: Base radius 0.875rem (14px); the scale is derived from it. Pills and full-round shapes are the most common; corners never go square.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: The base; every step below is derived from it.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: radius - 4px. Tiny label backplates inside timeline blocks.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: radius - 2px. The Button and Input primitives before call sites make them full.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: radius. Category swatches, timeline blocks on phones, small cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: radius + 4px. The Card primitive.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: radius + 8px. Tiles, day headers, list rows, radio/choice cards.

tokens.name: radius-3xl
tokens.usage: radius + 12px. Feature, trip and summary cards, dialogs, the zone-change card.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons in app chrome, nav items, chips, badges, tags, progress bars.

shadow.note: shadow-soft is the only elevation on cards. No hard or stacked shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-soft
tokens.usage: Feature cards, trip cards, sticky day headers, the zone-change card.
